label: Bible Study
prompt: He revealeth the deep and _____ things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
verse: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
note: Daniel's praise after God revealed Nebuchadnezzar's dream to him by night.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And David behaved himself _____ in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
verse: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
note: Even as Saul grew jealous, David behaved wisely in all his ways — and the LORD was with him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she dwelt under the _____ tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verse: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
note: Deborah held court under a palm tree in the hills of Ephraim — Israel's only woman judge, with an outdoor office.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Mary said, Behold the _____ of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
note: Mary's answer to Gabriel: no bargaining, no delay — just a servant's yes to the impossible.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go _____:
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
note: At the Red Sea, God told Moses to stop crying out and start marching: speak unto Israel, 'that they go forward.'
